scope: fixed low-cost L1 components only; complete paper experiments are not reproduced
available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac; no multi-device training assumed
model_scale: small seeded tensors, short synthetic streams and CPU arithmetic/state contracts; no pretrained model
data_scale: bounded synthetic diagnostic inputs; no downloaded benchmark, hidden test suite or production data
download_budget: zero checkpoint/data downloads; transfer only scoped public source and portable source proof
expected_cost: minutes rather than hours, based on bounded tensor/state sizes and prior comparable component runs; estimate, not a measured complete training time
full_experiment_decision: Costs are assessed individually in each selected catalog record; full model/data/production matrices are too costly and not reproduced (review DONE).
